submittedPrompt:
创作anon/resume/violet的完整1536×1024横向文学房间新母图。只有一张图像输入：本格目标主题的纯净空房。没有任何人物图像输入。此前同动作暖杏母图已完整亲读、亲看并转为以下文字理解，但本次不传入，不能从它继承任何日照高光。三张producer退回的局部硬亮面图绝不输入。人物从完整文字独立重新画在原房间里。保原窗格相机、桌椅/圆几/灯杯、凳垫的准确位置，不为人物展开桌面或移动圆几；目标空房就是空间和全部光源的唯一图像依据。

LIGHTING FIRST: 完整目标主题。凉润阴天或暮色的漫射环境光与既有低暖灯统一。 皮肤尤其膝/大腿、白领/衣袖、座垫和地板不能有从暖杏继承的硬白太阳斑、窗格阳光栅或日照锐边；不要仅把窗外改成主题、人物仍保白昼高亮。膝面用柔和连续的体积明暗，不能画一块贴上的白色高光。她坐原右侧阅读位，髋中心约x1010、头顶约y125，脚在约y840附近地板自然落地；这只是原房间尺度关系，不为坐标拉腿或移凳。

这是千早爱音／千早 愛音，MyGO!!!!!，不是祥子换色。她有长粉发与分束刘海、清楚灰蓝眼，青春学生的柔软面颊和不过长的轻下颌，聪明鲜活而非婴儿、木偶或成熟泛脸。羽丘原作服装结构：灰紫校服外套、浅色滚边、小金纽扣、白衬衫、深绿斜条领带、深绿与黄绿/金线格裙、深绿色膝下小腿长袜（袜口在膝以下、膝盖露出）、完整黑色乐福鞋。固有绿只属于衣服和自然植物，不成为绿色UI或全局染色。各色在当前光下自然变化，不能统一改灰。没有大型发饰，不加祥子的深发带、乐奈异色眼或猫元素。

本幅相处，先有自己的事与真实共同对象：
她先认出回来的人，眼里一点年轻的高兴，然后把膝上那一本仍留书签的原册页小幅转向两人之间。想分享新点子的兴奋与愿意先接上这一页的认真同时在场；不是接待式欢迎，也不声称替人已经查全资料。指尖保留真实书口，册子由膝和双手承托，不高举、不挥手。
这是项目原创的相处设想，册面只保留微淡不可读纸纹，不画能读出的引语、姓名、日期、历史消息、已经准备完成的声明或工具回执。

Exact target creative brief, all details apply as a living moment rather than mechanical labels:

palette: violet
title: 先把刚才那一页转回来
psychology: 人回来了，她一瞬间想展示新冒出的念头，随后先把两人刚才留着的那一页转回来。 想分享的兴奋与不愿把原来那件事弄丢的认真同时在场。 刚才没说透的意思在暮色里仍有位置。

expression: 眼睛先亮一下，随后回到具体而柔和的专注。 眼里一点高兴，唇线安静。
posture: 仍坐在原长凳阅读位，手中册页由膝承托，翻动很小。
support: window-bench-right
props: 一本保留书签的册页；不画历史消息、准备完成字样或虚构纪念物。
composition: 同一房间和同一材料维持连续，迎候不另搭舞台。
lighting: 暖近灯接住册页，紫灰窗景保留原湖岸层次。

暮色紫／完整黄昏：严格沿第一张空景紫灰山、玫瑰暮云、湖岸初灯与室内暖瓷灯。靠窗侧有轻紫灰环境反光，靠灯侧温暖，衣料/手/脸/木头一起接受该光场。不可一半白天一半夜晚、不可金色晴天窗。
Material continuity: local shadow planes must still describe young face, hands, cloth folds, white collar, dark-green socks, black loafers and pink hair. Keep eyes/bangs readable in the room scale. Natural warmth is a relation of the actual light sources, never a global amber/gray wash. Expressions follow this activity's exact brief, not a universal grin or Sakiko avatar smile.

Preserve the sole clean room input's complete close literary camera and mild perspective: large wooden window, same autumn lake town/mountains, ivory curtains, left writing desk and its original wood chair, shelf books/frames/plants, original round side table with blue-white porcelain lamp/cup/books/flowers, long wood window bench, linen cushion, right plaid cushions and knitted throw, wood floor/rug and softly blurred foreground plant. No furniture added or translated, no zoom/crop, moved window, extra desktop or floating stool. One person only, no extra off-camera hand. Table remains near original x435–690/top y500, left desk ends near x400 and chair stays near x260; these are room relations, not instructions to stretch the person.

Retain the approved activity's real placement on the ACTUAL BENCH: the right reading position beside the plaid cushions, with the book supported by lap/hands. Hips and thighs visibly rest on and compress the cushion, knees connect through natural lower legs and ankles to complete black loafers with honest floor/contact shadows. Preserve the near-camera whole-body scale and complete visible head/hands/knees/shoes; do not lengthen shins, enlarge head, distort joints, or move furniture merely to fit a rectangle. Parallel or gently offset legs must be coherent, not a crossed-knee pose pretending two parallel flat feet. No fused hands, extra fingers, broken wrists or unsupported paper. Existing foreground occlusion stays honest; never move a limb into a gap without support.

Keep real open visual breathing room on BOTH sides of the character, respecting the carefully specified real seated placement and the intact room; leave the left desk/window air and the free right cushion/window readable. Do not add gray/white panels, fake content, bright blank cards or an artificial UI safe-zone. No collaged edges, stickers, labels, borders, logos, icons, overlays, arrows, watermark or split day/night. Refined fresh TWO-DIMENSIONAL hand-drawn anime figure and soft painted room must share the same air, light and contact; no official near-3D model material. Produce the whole coherent scene as a new original image.
